subject.title: [Bug] Dreaming narrative: hardcoded 60s timeout includes lane-queue wait; timeout disposal aborts the primary call then discards the successful fallback-model output

question: What public memory-core Dream Diary timeout and cleanup contract should this issue use: timeout-only config, a broader narrative-controls contract, or an internal runtime fix with no new public config?
rationale: The bug is source-backed, but the durable fix changes plugin config/API semantics and timeout cleanup behavior that affect operators and future Dream Diary controls.

options.title: Broader Narrative Contract
options.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and cleanup/readback behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Timeout-Only First
options.body: Refresh and prove the existing timeout-config PR, while leaving queue-time attribution and late-output cleanup to a linked follow-up.

options.title: Internal Runtime Fix
options.body: Fix queue-time accounting and timeout cleanup internally while leaving operator-facing Dream Diary controls unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Broader Narrative Contract
recommendation.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and cleanup/readback behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core SDK/runtime history makes this the best available owner for the config and plugin-boundary decision.
